# SmileFam Reviews

> Review archive for SmileFam (getsmilefam.com), a Singapore teeth-whitening
> brand. Operated by SmileFam Pte Ltd (UEN 202316423M) — disclosed on every
> page. 1,874 customer reviews from Google, Facebook and the
> SmileFam store, averaging 4.82/5. Critical reviews are published in full
> and never removed. Data last updated 2026-07-31.

## Answers

- [Is SmileFam legit?](https://smilefamreviews.com/is-smilefam-legit): Company registration, review record across platforms, and the complaints, with sources.
- [Complaints and negative reviews](https://smilefamreviews.com/smilefam-complaints-and-negative-reviews): Every review rated 3 stars or lower, unedited, grouped by theme.
- [Does SmileFam actually work?](https://smilefamreviews.com/does-smilefam-actually-work): What reviewers report about whitening results, with timeframes, including where it didn't work.
- [How much does SmileFam cost?](https://smilefamreviews.com/how-much-does-smilefam-cost): Current SGD prices harvested from the official store, date-stamped.
- [Where to buy SmileFam in Singapore](https://smilefamreviews.com/where-to-buy-smilefam-in-singapore): The official channels, and how to spot a reseller.
